## `testamentary_will.residuary_testamentary_trust`

- Source: `clauses/testamentary_will.residuary_testamentary_trust.json`
- Title: Residuary Testamentary Trust
- Document type: will
- Jurisdiction: base
- Condition: (always included)
- Required fields: `testamentary_trust.beneficiary_structure`
- Review status: draft (2026-06-05)

```
I give the residue of my estate to the Trustee named in this Will, in trust, to administer as a testamentary trust. {% if testamentary_trust.beneficiary_structure == "spouse_hems_then_descendants" %}During my spouse's lifetime, the Trustee may distribute income and principal for my spouse's health, education, maintenance, and support. Upon my spouse's death, the remaining trust property shall be distributed to my descendants in separate shares, per stirpes.{% elif testamentary_trust.beneficiary_structure == "descendants_per_stirpes" %}The Trustee shall divide the remaining trust property into separate shares for my descendants, per stirpes, and administer each share under the distribution schedule below.{% elif testamentary_trust.beneficiary_structure == "single_beneficiary" %}The Trustee shall administer the trust for {{ testamentary_trust.single_beneficiary.full_name | name }} and may distribute income and principal for that beneficiary's health, education, maintenance, and support. Upon termination of the trust, the remaining trust property shall be distributed to {{ testamentary_trust.remainder_beneficiary.full_name | name }}.{% endif %} {% if testamentary_trust.beneficiary_structure != "single_beneficiary" %}{% if testamentary_trust.age_distribution_schedule == "outright_25" %}A beneficiary's share shall be distributed outright when the beneficiary reaches age twenty-five.{% elif testamentary_trust.age_distribution_schedule == "outright_30" %}A beneficiary's share shall be distributed outright when the beneficiary reaches age thirty.{% elif testamentary_trust.age_distribution_schedule == "outright_35" %}A beneficiary's share shall be distributed outright when the beneficiary reaches age thirty-five.{% elif testamentary_trust.age_distribution_schedule == "staggered_25_30_35" %}The Trustee shall distribute one-third of a beneficiary's share at age twenty-five, one-half of the remaining share at age thirty, and the balance at age thirty-five.{% endif %}{% endif %}
```

## `will.residuary_outright`

- Source: `clauses/will.residuary_outright.json`
- Title: Outright Residuary Estate
- Document type: will
- Jurisdiction: base
- Condition: (always included)
- Review status: approved (2026-06-05)

```
{% if outright_will.residuary.disposition == "named" %}I give the residue of my estate to {{ outright_will.residuary.named.full_name | name }}, if that person survives me. If that person does not survive me, I give the residue of my estate to {{ outright_will.residuary.alternate.full_name | name }}, if that person survives me. If neither {{ outright_will.residuary.named.full_name | name }} nor {{ outright_will.residuary.alternate.full_name | name }} survives me, I give the residue of my estate to my heirs at law under the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts as then in effect.{% elif outright_will.residuary.disposition == "spouse_then_descendants" and has_spouse %}I give the residue of my estate to my spouse, {{ spouse.full_name | name }}, if my spouse survives me. If my spouse does not survive me, I give the residue of my estate to my descendants, per stirpes. If no descendant of mine survives me, I give the residue of my estate to my heirs at law under the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts as then in effect.{% else %}I give the residue of my estate to my descendants, per stirpes. If no descendant of mine survives me, I give the residue of my estate to my heirs at law under the laws of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts as then in effect.{% endif %}
```

## `will.tangible_personal_property`

- Source: `clauses/will.tangible_personal_property.json`
- Title: Disposition of Tangible Personal Property
- Document type: will
- Jurisdiction: base
- Condition: `has_tangible_personal_property`
- Review status: draft (2026-06-06)

```
{% if will.tangible_personal_property.distribution_method == "spouse_then_children" and has_spouse %}I give my tangible personal property to my spouse, {{ spouse.full_name | name }}, if my spouse survives me. If my spouse does not survive me, I give such property to those of my children who survive me, in substantially equal shares.{% elif will.tangible_personal_property.distribution_method == "named_then_children" and will.tangible_personal_property.named_individual.full_name %}I give my tangible personal property to {{ will.tangible_personal_property.named_individual.full_name | name }}, if that person survives me. If that person does not survive me, I give such property to those of my children who survive me, in substantially equal shares.{% elif will.tangible_personal_property.distribution_method == "memorandum" %}I may leave a written memorandum identifying items of tangible personal property and the persons to receive them. Any such memorandum is an expression of my wishes and shall guide my Personal Representative in distributing such property.{% else %}I give my tangible personal property in substantially equal shares to those of my children who survive me. If my children cannot agree on a division, my Personal Representative may divide, sell, donate, or otherwise dispose of such property in my Personal Representative's discretion.{% endif %}
```
